name: stay, time limit, case-insensitive letters: a pause and a repeated wrong key
why: Targets: single letters f j d k (no trailing spaces). caseSensitive is false, so 'F' is accepted for 'f'.
Keys: F j, pause at 4000, resume at 9000, x x (both wrong for d, same position), d. The key k at 22000 arrives at the deadline and is not typed.
startedAtT = 2000. Active time at 22000 = (4000 - 2000) + (22000 - 9000) = 15000 = the limit, so the session ends there. activeMs = 15000, minutes = 0.25.
keystrokes = F j x x d = 5. correct = 3. errors = 2. accuracy = 3 / 5 = 0.6.
Latencies: every letter is the first char of its target; only d has an earlier key in its target (the second x at 11000), so 12000 - 11000 = 1000. One sample, so consistency = 0.
Streak: F j = 2, broken by x; d = 1. longestStreak = 2.
perKey d: the first x is an attempt and an error; the second x is a repeat at the same stay position and is not counted per key; d is a right attempt. So 2 attempts, 1 error.
No bigrams: every target is one char. targetsCompleted = 3 (f, j, d).
